name: consensus-mine
title: Consensus Mine
description: Predict the 'Hive Mind'—the collective preferences of everyone in the room. If you can't read the room, you'll be stuck in the mines forever.
instructions: Everyone ranks a list of items. Then, teams take turns guessing the most popular items. Avoid the traps!

amen.title: The Council
amen.description: Predict how the group will rank these choices. Think like the flock to earn your place on the council.
